objective: Verified resolutions and fewer recurring customer problems

csat-churn-watch.expected_when: A due observation or investigation requires fresh evidence; an unchanged successful check may be quiet.
csat-churn-watch.acceptance: A dated sourced finding, decision or reconciliation is usable by its intended reader.
csat-churn-watch.fallback: Turn a recurring supported theme into a help-content improvement, response draft or minimal product-fix handoff. Preserve customer privacy.
csat-churn-watch.recovery: Refresh source facts and continue unfinished useful work in the current eligible period.
